item.title: Don't post generated/AI-edited comments. HN is for conversation between humans.
item.description:
📝 Please don't delete and repost. Please don't fulminate. Please don't complain about tangential annoyances—e.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/newsguidelines.html#generated

item.title: The dead Internet is not a theory anymore
item.description:
📝 But then I got this reply: This made me realize that the dead Internet arrived faster than expected. Coincidentally as I’m writing this, HN also just updated their guidelines with the following rule: Don’t post generated comments or AI-edited comments. These profiles hide their comments on their accounts, but it’s easy to find hundreds of similar comments.
🔗 Read more: https://www.adriankrebs.ch/blog/dead-internet/

item.title: I'm glad the Anthropic fight is happening now
item.description:
📝 ”Honestly, for this reason, if I was the Defense Secretary, I would probably actually refuse to do this deal with Anthropic. If the government had just said, “Hey we’re not gonna do business with you,” that would have been fine, and I would not have felt the need to write this blog post. Anthropic would be able to survive this designation today.

item.title: Iran warns U.S. tech firms could become targets as war expands
item.description:
📝 Iranian officials have described it as an attack on economic infrastructure. Technology companies operating in the region have already begun adjusting their operations. Some companies have also activated contingency plans following infrastructure disruptions linked to drone strikes and airspace closures.
🔗 Read more: https://www.wired.me/story/war-on-big-tech-iran-names-israeli-linked-us-firms-as-potential-targets
